name: Jukebox Soundies
description: Three-minute Soundies from the 1940s Panoram jukeboxes and swing-era film clips with Cab Calloway, Louis Armstrong, Fats Waller, Louis Jordan, the Andrews Sisters and Glenn Miller, plus Duke Ellington's Black and Tan, Bessie Smith's St. Louis Blues, The Sound of Jazz and 1950s TV music shows with Perry Como, Patti Page, Rosemary Clooney, Liberace and Frankie Laine. Your Hit Parade counts down the week's top tunes Saturday nights at 10:30, and The Dinah Shore Chevy Show airs Sundays at 9:00 pm.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 60 hours: 1940s Soundies from the Prelinger Archives, 16mm prints and Mills Panoram reels, 1928-1956 jazz, swing and blues film clips, Black and Tan, St. Louis Blues and Cab Calloway's Hi-De-Ho, The Sound of Jazz and Art Ford's Jazz Party, and 1950s TV music shows (Perry Como, Patti Page, Rosemary Clooney, Liberace, Frankie Laine, Coke Time, The Big Record), plus Your Hit Parade and Dinah Shore Chevy Show slots; burlesque soundies, comedy and novelty-act soundies, untitled and duplicate prints, a full-length feature, colorized/AI-restored clips, audio-only record uploads, modern mashups and retrospectives excluded. No commercial breaks: the clips are too short and the TV shows keep their original sponsor spots.
